title: FailureDiagnosis
description: JSON schema for failure and error diagnostics generated by LDrago Coding Brain

failure_summary.description: Succinct summary of the observed failure, panic, or bug

root_cause.description: Identified primary mechanism or trigger causing the defect

hypotheses.description: Ranked hypotheses regarding secondary factors or competing explanations

hypothesis.description: Statement of candidate cause or contributing condition

reasoning.description: Technical analysis connecting symptoms to this hypothesis

evidence.description: Concrete log lines, stack trace frames, or code snippets

affected_files.description: Files and modules implicated in the defect

relevance.description: Role of this file in the defect

verification_plan.description: Ordered steps to verify the root cause or confirm resolution

step.description: Diagnostic action or test execution description

command.description: Exact terminal command to reproduce or verify

expected_outcome.description: Outcome proving hypothesis validity or defect resolution

suggested_fix.description: High-level guidance or code patch recommendation
